table_title: Table 9.9.3.58.1: UE radio capability ID availability information element
columns: UE radio capability ID availability value (bits 3 to 1 of octet 3)
rows: UE radio capability ID not available
All other values are interpreted as UE radio capability ID not available by this version of the protocol.
Bits 4 to 8 of octet 3 are spare and shall be coded as zero.
